subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Valves: Controlling Flow
description: A 60-second lesson on Valves: Controlling Flow.

hook.text: Turn a handle and water stops. Open it and water flows. Valves decide.

buildup.text: Gate valves open wide for full flow. Globe valves throttle for control.

discovery.text: Check valves allow flow one way only, preventing dangerous backflow.

twist.text: A valve sized too small creates huge pressure loss and wastes pump energy.

climax.text: Refineries use thousands of valves. Each one is chosen for a specific job.

punchline.text: The humble valve is the traffic cop of every pipe system.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a check valve?
options: To allow flow in one direction only and prevent backflow
To shut off flow completely for maintenance
